## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues and note any
compatibility or operator impact.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results, and any skips or limitations.
For documentation-only changes, describe example and link validation.

## Safety and operational impact

If relevant, describe permissions, target routing, approval behavior, destructive
actions, retry/persistence behavior, or dependency changes. Otherwise write N/A.
Distinguish mocked checks from live checks; a production environment is not
required for a PR.

## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/RekklesNA/ProxmoxMCP-Plus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept the change scoped.
- [ ] I added relevant regression coverage, or explained why it is not needed.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation/examples, or explained why none change.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private configuration, and sensitive log details.

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately using the
[Security Policy](https://github.com/RekklesNA/ProxmoxMCP-Plus/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md),
not in a public PR description.
